info.title: ComplianceForge Production API
info.summary: Tenant-isolated governance, risk, and compliance API
info.description: The production contract for the required API slice. Tenant identity is never accepted from a caller-selected header: authenticated user operations derive organization_id from the validated access token, while automation operations derive it from the API-key principal. Optional nil-mounted legacy domains are deliberately excluded.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token. The validated organization_id claim establishes the tenant boundary. Refresh tokens are not accepted here.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Hashed, revocable tenant credential. Every automation operation also requires its exact read scope and applies a per-key quota.

scimBearerAuth.description: Dedicated high-entropy SCIM credential. Only its SHA-256 digest is stored; it establishes one tenant, exact Users/Groups scopes, expiry, and a per-token rate limit. Browser JWTs and general API keys are not accepted.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Results per page; handlers cap oversized values.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated key that makes a mutating import safely replayable with identical content.

ChangeReason.name: X-Change-Reason
ChangeReason.description: Human-readable, audit-recorded reason for the administrative change.

StepUpToken.name: X-Step-Up-Token
StepUpToken.description: Short-lived, one-time, session-bound proof for the exact sensitive operation being attempted.

RequestID.description: Correlation identifier for logs and support.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745 structured date identifying when this compatibility alias became deprecated.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 HTTP-date after which the compatibility alias may be removed.

SuccessorLink.description: RFC 8288 Link to the canonical successor resource using rel=successor-version.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated principal lacks the required permission or scope.

PaymentRequired.description: The subscription does not include the capability (`ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`) or its atomic resource limit is exhausted (`ENTITLEMENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`).

value.message: This capability is not included in the current subscription
The subscription limit for this resource has been reached

FeatureForbidden.description: The principal lacks permission, or an entitled capability is disabled by an operational or tenant override (`FEATURE_DISABLED`).

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is syntactically valid but refers to an unavailable tenant resource.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the operation's bounded upload limit.

InternalError.description: Internal failure; implementation details are never returned.

DependencyUnavailable.description: A required authentication, authorization, quota, tenant, or downstream dependency is temporarily unavailable.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required dependency is not ready.

EvaluationUnavailable.description: Feature or entitlement evaluation failed closed (`FEATURE_EVALUATION_UNAVAILABLE` or `ENTITLEMENT_EVALUATION_UNAVAILABLE`).

value.message: Feature availability could not be verified
Subscription capacity could not be verified

GenericResponse.description: Domain response whose detailed schema is not yet part of material cross-client drift enforcement.

GenericMutation.description: Domain mutation payload; operation-specific handler validation still applies.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Handler errors use lower snake case; product access gates use documented upper snake case codes.

metadata.description: JSON object encoded as a multipart text field.
JSON object encoded as a multipart text field.

DirectoryCSVImport.description: UTF-8 CSV document, from 1 byte through 2 MiB.

OrganizationContactProjection.description: Reviewed contact projection; field policy can omit/mask read fields.

OrganizationProfileProjection.description: Reviewed fields only. GET may return a policy-masked/hidden projection; absence or masking never permits editing. Legacy textual fields remain readable for corrective administration.

editable.description: Unmasked-projection evidence only, NOT settings:configure authorization.

OrganizationProfileEnvelope.description: Normal GET supplies the full profile and canonical metadata; field policy may remove/mask read fields or metadata. Editing requires independently verified configure permission and exact unmasked metadata.

email.description: Plain ASCII email; no display name, Unicode, whitespace or control characters.

reason.description: Required bounded nonempty human change reason; do not include credentials or unnecessary personal data.

country_code.description: Two-uppercase-letter syntax only, not an ISO registry lookup.

timezone.description: Known IANA identifier; Local and invalid identifiers are rejected.

supported_languages.description: Must include the effective default language.

contacts.description: At most one contact per purpose; informational only. Empty array clears contacts.

OrganizationProfileUpdateInput.description: Presence-aware PUT: omitted fields preserved, explicit null and duplicate keys rejected. At least one editable field required. Fiscal date must be valid in a non-leap recurring calendar (Feb29 is rejected). Maximum 8192 bytes, no blind retry or idempotency-key promise.

DataQualitySnapshot.description: Fixed complete tenant aggregate ruleset, no IDs, samples, raw messages or repair writes. One MVCC snapshot; deadline, incomplete RLS visibility, schema mismatch or partial results return503, never an inferred healthy status.

consent.description: Explicit consent for this download. No automatic transmission to support occurs.

scope.description: Reviewed aggregate-health and configuration-posture allowlist only; no raw logs, credentials, endpoints, business records, or user identifiers.
